content.text: Digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable face a significant barrier. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-5|The Full]] problem limits the ability to connect with global audiences and monetize digital products effectively. The need for a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to sell digital assets without relying on restricted platforms is paramount. With the right setup, anyone can establish an efficient online store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-6|crypto]]currency payment processing. Let’s analyze the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-19|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]s available and determine which one truly works for those ready to break free from traditional payment restrictions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

When it comes to selling digital products, various architectures provide distinct capabilities. The Sovereign Starter Stack offers a straightforward solution with GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, enabling creators to set up a basic store quickly. It allows for three products but lacks advanced features for scalability. On the other hand, the Edge Commerce Stack incorporates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, creating a robust infrastructure for five products, complete email authentication, and ongoing support. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit combines all blueprints and templates, providing a comprehensive solution for those looking to scale their operations and optimize their digital storefront. Understanding each stack's limitations and advantages is critical for choosing the best option based on individual needs.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The chosen architecture must effectively address the challenges posed by restricted countries. The Sovereign Starter Stack, while quick to deploy, may leave creators limited in features essential for navigating regional restrictions. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed with flexibility in mind, utilizing Cloudflare's infrastructure to maintain performance and security across various regions, making it well-suited for digital creators in Kenya. The Complete Builder Kit is built to handle these challenges comprehensively, providing a full suite of documentation and templates, enabling creators to adapt to fluctuating environments seamlessly. This adaptability is crucial for sustained growth and ensuring consistent access to global markets.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and overall costs are critical considerations when selecting an architecture for selling digital products. Using NOWPayments with both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack ensures that transactions are processed quickly, with fees at just 0.5%. This is significantly lower than traditional platforms that often charge exorbitant fees. Additionally, cryptocurrency transactions on recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON incur minimal costs, often under $0.10 per transaction, enabling creators to maximize their profits. With automated webhook notifications upon payment confirmation, creators can deliver products instantly, enhancing the overall customer experience and further solidifying their operations.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators like never before.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A critical aspect of choosing the right architecture is ensuring complete ownership of your digital assets. With COREMERCH’s solutions, creators retain full control post-deployment, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms. The Sovereign Starter Stack provides basic automation through Google Apps Script, allowing for product delivery upon payment confirmation. The Edge Commerce Stack enhances this automation with Cloudflare Workers, ensuring seamless delivery of digital products. The Complete Builder Kit encapsulates these features and offers advanced templates, ensuring that the entire process is streamlined and efficient. This ownership model is vital for creators looking to build a sustainable business without the fear of losing access to their infrastructure or data.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding which architecture to implement comes down to evaluating personal requirements and future aspirations. If you require a quick setup and are just starting with a few products, the Sovereign Starter Stack may be adequate. However, for those seeking a more robust solution capable of scaling with their business, the Edge Commerce Stack provides greater flexibility and advanced features. The Complete Builder Kit is ideal for those ready to invest in their digital storefront comprehensively, as it offers all necessary documentation and tools for immediate implementation. Ultimately, the choice depends on how soon you want to launch, the number of products you plan to sell, and your long-term business goals.

For digital creators in Kenya, the most effective architecture is the Edge Commerce Stack, as it combines robust features with flexibility, allowing for future growth. The Complete Builder Kit also offers a comprehensive solution, ensuring you have all the tools needed to succeed without depending on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal. Implementing these architectures enables full ownership and control over your digital products while utilizing efficient crypto payment processing.
Eliminate dependency on restrictive payment platforms.

For an all-in-one solution that includes everything you need to kickstart your digital product sales, consider the Complete Builder Kit. At just $197, it encompasses all blueprints and templates necessary to establish a fully functional online store, tailored for creators looking to thrive without the constraints of conventional payment processors.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your architecture: Decide between the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or the Complete Builder Kit based on your needs. 2. Set up hosting: Utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your online storefront. 3. Implement backend logic: Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling payment processing and product delivery. 4. Integrate order storage: Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for managing product orders efficiently. 5. Set up file delivery: Leverage Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivering digital products seamlessly. 6. Configure NOWPayments for crypto payments, ensuring you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does the payment processing work?

Payment processing is handled through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, the system automatically delivers the purchased product to the customer.
What are the fees associated with these architectures?
Both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack utilize NOWPayments, which charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than traditional payment processors.
How quickly can I set up my digital store?
You can have your store up and running within 48 hours with either the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, depending on the complexity you need.
What happens after I purchase the Complete Builder Kit?
Upon purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, you gain immediate access to all necessary documentation and templates to efficiently set up your digital storefront.
Can I scale my business with these options?
Yes, both the Edge Commerce Stack and Complete Builder Kit are designed to scale with your business, allowing you to add more products and features as needed.
